_note: Survival Mode gate way back layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Opacities 0 to 1.

gate._note: top: the art has this much extra above and below, for the shake; travel_pad: how far past the screen edge an open half rests; half_width: a half's width when the texture reports none

dust._note: count puffs from the seam, alternating sides, the first at first_y and each spacing_y below; each is seam_offset off the seam, turned angle_step_deg more than the previous one, and scaled by base_scale plus up to scale_spread
